cohort: 5,355 live births complicated by gastroschisis from 2014 to 2020 in the US
finding: Attempted vaginal delivery among pregnancies complicated by gastroschisis increased significantly from 2014 to 2020, but Hispanic women and those aged 35-39 were less likely to attempt vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Attempted vaginal delivery rates increased significantly among pregnancies complicated by gastroschisis.
